result.reason: The operative language includes the preferred limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it unnecessarily adds an at-own-expense requirement and a one-year post-termination tail that applies broadly to all coverages, neither of which is required by the playbook. It also triggers cyber coverage for mere access to any Company data or Confidential Information, which is broader than vendors processing Customer Data. These additions create material obligations beyond the requested insurance position and do not preserve the original commercial scope. The drafting is generally readable, but the overbroad tail and cyber trigger reduce precision.
